# Owned temporal evidence fixtures

All addresses use documentation prefixes; names use `.invalid`. Hex MRT framing
and reference expansions are authored for this project, not downloaded records.
These are correctness fixtures, never natural activity evidence. The UPDATE has
two IPv4 NLRI and no attributes; it tests syntactic expansion, not BGP validity.
Identity vectors are independently serialized literal preimages and SHA-256,
not values generated by the implementation under test. No live API calls.
